actions.exclude_lot: Entry generates no page and appears in no listing (bundle/lot or non-product entry, not a single model). No redirect: there is no model page to point at. Watchlist entries keyed to it are dropped by the watchlist migration in src/layouts/Layout.astro.
actions.hold: Entry keeps its current slug, names and behaviour. Used only where a product identity cannot be supported from the listing title; guessing a name would be worse than waiting.
actions.keep: Entry stays a model page. canonicalNameEn / canonicalNameJaClean replace the raw listing titles and newSlug replaces the slug (old URL gets a static redirect).
actions.merge_into: Entry generates no page of its own. Its sales fold into the model named by mergeInto (an original export slug). Fold rules (implemented in src/lib/data.ts): sold volumes sum; price range takes min/max across entries; medians, USD medians, trend and average sell hours are volume-weighted averages of the source medians (weights: soldVolume90d for overall/condition medians, soldVolume30d for trend), rounded to the nearest yen; USD overall median is recomputed from the merged JPY median at the export exchange rate; by-condition grades merge per grade with the same weighting; time series merge per date with volume-weighted medians; the source's cleaned Japanese name is added to the target's aliases. The old URL gets a static redirect to the target's final URL.

_meta.scope: Dispositions for all 52 model-<hash> fallback slugs in data/export.json, plus one extra entry (dx-bandai) for the non-hash merge target that needed a clean name. Keys are existing export slugs. This file is an overlay only: data/export.json and the export contract are never edited.
